scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && vite build --mode chrome && vite build --mode firefox && vite build --mode safari
scripts.zip: web-ext build -s dist/chrome -a artifacts -n bukmark-chrome-{version}.zip -o && web-ext build -s dist/firefox -a artifacts -n bukmark-firefox-{version}.zip -o && web-ext build -s dist/safari -a artifacts -n bukmark-safari-{version}.zip -o
